meadowLod.method: Whole source-connected leaf/blade components, with bounded connected original-triangle patches for oversized fused shrubs; no vertex movement, new edges, UV edits, or texture changes

meadowFarLod.method: Whole source-connected leaf/blade components, with bounded connected original-triangle patches for oversized fused shrubs; no vertex movement, new edges, UV edits, or texture changes

vegetationLod.method: Meshopt simplifyWithAttributes; NORMAL weight .5, TEXCOORD_0 weight 1.5; no canopy component pruning; canopy keeps >=60% surface and each-axis projected area; trunk-only budget1500; original surviving vertex data preserved; separate Float32 vertex layout
vegetationLod.runtimeMatch: Exact source mesh/node order and names; exact primitive order; native materials and instance transforms retained by renderer

terrainLod.method: Attribute-aware meshopt simplification in distance bands, at most 1mrad source-vertex screen error from site origin and 20m absolute error, locked native boundary edges and every source triangle touching the 250m site radius. Surviving attribute values copied exactly; lossless vertex/index reordering and compression, no quantization. Every source vertex checked against LOD surface; this is not a formal continuous Hausdorff bound.
terrainLod.runtimeMatch: Exact source mesh/node/primitive order and names; renderer reuses native materials.

meadowCloseLod.method: Compare 512/1024/2048 triangle candidates using native MASK-texture alpha-tested XY/XZ/YZ union at256px. Material-isolated Meshopt simplifyWithAttributes compares absolute0.25%,0.5%,1%,2%height error, normal weights.02height and UV.1height; compare original-component alternative. Greedy union coverage selects whole components when <=128tri, connected original-index patches otherwise. Triangle budget is hard;75%intersection/reference is a measured target, exceptions are reported. Error bound applies to attribute simplification before component omission, not omitted source surfaces. Surviving positions/normals/UV exact; separate Float32attributes; native source unchanged.
meadowCloseLod.label: Native grass close silhouette

landscape.method: Exact retained geometry; omit only replaced terrain nodes with the same prefixes used by the renderer

visibilityTransfer.method: Offline nearest-surface barycentric transfer of source canopy visibility; full native positions, normals and UVs
